title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: rejecting a registered notice of loss
content:
## Situation of use

This entry belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. It applies when a notice of loss registered on a cover is decided at once by rejection, with a controlled reason. A notice can be decided here only once it has been registered on the cover.

## Entry condition

The notice being decided is registered on the cover, carrying its amount, container, kind of loss, apparent-at-delivery flag and notice date.

## What the tool does

One call of reject_cargo_claim_5f9631bd books one rejection entry of 0.00 USD on the cover's premium and settlement account for the claim, dated today, carrying the controlled reason and the claimant of the file, and marks the claim file as rejected. The cover's status is left unchanged. On success the claimant can be told the rejection reference and the reason.

## How it is invoked

reject_cargo_claim_5f9631bd is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the desk agent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| cover_id | Cover reference number of the cargo cover the claim is lodged under, as returned by the cover lookup or the claim file lookup | Identifier |
| claim_id | Claim reference number of the claim file being rejected, as returned by the claim file lookup or by the lodging receipt | Identifier |
| rejection_reason | Controlled reason for the rejection | One value from the enum below |

### rejection_reason values

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| notice_out_of_time | Written notice reached the line after the notice window for that kind of loss |
| claim_time_barred | Notice reached the line after the claim time bar |
| excluded_peril | The survey found the claimant's insufficient packing or inherent vice caused the loss |
| not_covered_by_tier | The product does not pay this kind of loss, or temperature damage on a container whose reefer service rank is too low |
| no_logged_excursion | A temperature claim without the required logged excursion |
| misdeclared_cargo | The goods' dangerous-goods acceptance carries a misdeclaration penalty |
| below_minimum_claim | The amount is below the product's minimum claim |
| documents_not_submitted | The documents deadline passed without complete documents |
| claimant_not_entitled | The claimant is neither the cover holder nor an admitted named consignee |
| not_applicable | Never correct for a rejection; used only on other entries |

## Return

On success the tool returns: status ("rejected" when the rejection entry was booked); rejection_event_id (reference of the new rejection entry); claim_id; cover_id; rejection_reason (the recorded reason); amount_usd (always 0.00 USD on a rejection).

## Basis Q&A

**Does a rejection move the cover out of the open-claim state?** No. The call leaves the cover's status unchanged.

**Is any money booked on a rejection?** The entry is booked at 0.00 USD.
